races.title: Why Bet Elsewhere, David Lucas Bookmakers Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: The betting will undoubtedly prove informative but MOMENTS IN TIME showed plenty when twice finishing fourth in bumpers last season and, following a subsequent breathing operation, looks very interesting now hurdling over a trip that should suit. Course bumper winner Bande Organisee is another of firm interest, with Exeter scorer All About Trev and Kimai 2 others entering the reckoning. races.title: Guaranteed Odds At David Lucas Bookmakers Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict: SEA THE DAY impressed with his attitude when seeing off a point winner in a C&D bumper on his debut last November before finishing mid-field in a strong race at Ascot, and rates another fine hurdling prospect for his top yard. Common Sense showed plenty under an enterprising ride on his first start over hurdles at Ffos Las recently and is sure to pose a big threat if brushing up his jumping, while Herbies Sock and Passage Guenot are others to consider. SEA THE DAY (IRE) COMMON SENSE (IRE) HERBIES SOCK (IRE)

races.title: McCarthy Construction Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict: A progressive winner in bumpers, OLD HABITS shaped encouragingly starting out over hurdles when third at Perth 5 weeks ago and, with this stiffer track promising to play to his strengths, he could well take full advantage of the weight he receives from fellow useful prospect Hidden Mountain , who was impressive at Worcester 3 weeks ago. Point winner's Moltezuma and Justoneglance are others to note. OLD HABITS (IRE) HIDDEN MOUNTAIN MOLTEZUMA (IRE)

races.title: Treble Odds L15s At David Lucas Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: Not the easiest race to get a handle on but last year's winner BEN SOLO has yet to run a bad race here and with his Ffos Las reappearance under his belt, he could be the answer with his yard having made a bright start to the campaign. There are several interesting chase debutants in opposition, though, with Largy Go , Wilstar and Quay Item respected before market clues. Sogna In Grande is another to note. BEN SOLO (IRE) LARGY GO (IRE) WILSTAR (IRE)

races.title: Happy 80th Birthday Pamela Hall Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: There were more encouraging signs from PATRIOTIK on chasing debut last time, and he's fancied to capitalise on a very attractive mark. Hat-trick-seeking Gingerbred looks the obvious danger, with Better Off Alone , Jongleur D'Etoiles and The Long Point also appealing in a competitive race for the grade.
